summary: Today’s feed: Vercel and Cloudflare product updates, OpenAI v7 memory push, rising local/OSS agent runtimes and MCP tooling, plus early social reports on Claude Code UX and a claimed Plugin4Shell RCE.

candidates.title: Vercel AI SDK & Workflow releases
candidates.why_it_matters: Vercel shipped workflow SDK/harness and Jev HTTP/API updates for agent deployments.
candidates.next_check: Scan changelogs for breaking API changes and Jev integration examples.

candidates.title: Cloudflare: Python Workers generally available
candidates.why_it_matters: Python edge runtime GA broadens where agent code and sandboxes can run in-edge.
candidates.next_check: Assess compatibility with common agent sandboxes and native C/Python libs.

candidates.title: OpenAI: v7 / institutional memory push
candidates.why_it_matters: OpenAI v7 emphasizes institutional memory features useful for multi-session agents.
candidates.next_check: Validate memory API surface and pricing impact on agent designs.

candidates.title: Sandbase-harness: local-first agent runtime & MCP bridge
candidates.why_it_matters: Local-first runtime with sandboxed sessions, credentials, audit/replay for agents.
candidates.next_check: Find demos or third-party writeups to corroborate adoption and security model.

candidates.title: Omnigent: open-source multi-agent harness
candidates.why_it_matters: Large OSS orchestrator for multi-provider agents, policy and sandboxing hooks.
candidates.next_check: Audit integrations, documentation and real-world deployments.

candidates.title: ehmo/gum — CLI and MCP server for discovering Google APIs
candidates.why_it_matters: CLI + MCP server to let agents call Google APIs cleanly from scripts/agents.
candidates.next_check: Look for usage examples and security/credential patterns.

candidates.title: Bivack: cloud dev sandbox for coding agents (AWS Lambda MicroVMs)
candidates.why_it_matters: Shows per-user Lambda MicroVM + persistent S3 home for safe agent dev and UIs.
candidates.next_check: Verify cost and reproducibility; check repo/examples if published.
